construction.implementation_origin: Written from scratch as an isolated reference implementation

input.question: Nonblank string, maximum 2000 characters
input.team_online: Required boolean; supplied availability is not independently verified
input.knowledge_base: Required array, 0-100 articles; unique nonblank id and title (maximum 200 characters), body (maximum 4000 characters), optional keywords array (0-30 strings, maximum 100 characters each)

output.success: resolution (answered or escalated), answer, citations [{id,title,excerpt}], handoff {needed,reason,team_online,delivery,summary}

shared_schema.validation: Shared Validator validates requests and optional injected selector output. Unknown fields, duplicate IDs, invalid types and invalid lengths are rejected. CLI additionally rejects duplicate JSON keys, nonfinite JSON values, files larger than 1000000 bytes, malformed JSON and inaccessible files.
shared_schema.optional_callable: support(payload, selector=None); selector receives question and retrieved candidates and returns only article_ids, a unique subset of retrieved IDs of length 0-3. Failures become ValidationError. Arbitrary generated answers are prohibited.

cross_stage_handoffs: Single integrated stage: validated request -> deterministic retrieval -> optional validated article selection -> cited answer or unsent human handoff suggestion.
behavior: Synthetic example store data is explicitly labeled and is not a real commercial policy.
English ASCII-alphanumeric tokens, case-insensitive matching, fixed stopword removal, minimum 50 percent query-token overlap, maximum three articles, score then ID tie-breaking.
Answers copy article bodies verbatim and cite IDs and titles. No unsupported model-generated policy claims.
Unknown questions, empty knowledge and selector abstentions produce honest online/offline handoff suggestions without claiming a ticket was sent.

included: Deterministic grounded FAQ retrieval and extractive answers
Offline support, human-contact suggestions, bounded input validation
JSON CLI and standard-library unittest coverage
excluded: Live LLMs, network calls, provider integrations
Ticket delivery, state persistence, customer account actions
Enterprise authorization, multilingual semantic retrieval, policy conflict resolution
Verification of supplied knowledge accuracy; knowledge base must be trusted
Guaranteed relevance from lexical overlap, calibrated confidence or conversational memory
